codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured implementation of component event emission for the katla_ecs World. The feature covers all 7 VAL-ECS assertions (006-012) with 9 unit tests. The code follows existing patterns established by the entity events system, uses appropriate Rust idioms, and integrates cleanly with the existing storage layer.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission AGENTS.md correctly documents that events live in katla_ecs/src/events.rs, which the worker followed. It also documents the Vec-based queue pattern and flush-at-end-of-update lifecycle. The worker's implementation was fully consistent with these guidelines — no gaps.

The worker changed add_component from impl Trait to generic<T> to access TypeId::of::<T>(). This is a reasonable approach but it's a subtle API change that narrows the function signature. No existing callers were broken since the storage layer already used generics. Future workers should be aware that World::add_component is now generic<T> rather than impl Trait.
sharedStateObservations.suggestedContent: World::add_component<T: Component + 'static>(id, component) is generic over T to capture TypeId for ComponentEvent::Added emission. This was changed from impl Trait to generic<T> in commit 1f02b72. component_events_for::<T>() returns Vec<&ComponentEvent> filtered by TypeId. Events are accumulated in Vec<ComponentEvent> and flushed at end of update().

summary: Component events feature passes review. Implementation is clean, well-tested (9 tests covering all 7 VAL-ECS assertions plus an extra accumulation-across-frames test), and follows established patterns. The add_component signature change from impl Trait to generic<T> is the most notable design decision but is justified and correct. No bugs or edge cases missed. Clippy passes, all workspace tests pass.
